dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible are approximately 4-5 irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The most prominent central annulus features a sharp, jagged high-contrast light perimeter with a high-frequency staccato edge geometry. A dorsal 'C' shape shows a softer gradient transition from the dark exterior to the light interior boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid low-intensity (dark) pigment clusters concentrated in the mid-flank. These clusters exhibit high core pixel concentration with very little internal variance, separated by thin, high-intensity (light) interstitial lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-lateral annuli form an elongated, near-isosceles triangle with the apex pointing toward the dorsal ridge. Secondary centroids on the posterior flank form a dense, irregular polygonal network.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior region displays a unique reticulated 'honeycomb' pattern where light-intensity lines intersect to form a contiguous mesh of dark polygons.
